author: ClaudioStabile

title: 2nd-day-review
body:
I got caught by this nice „Krake“ which represents my life in some parts 🤪

Yesterday installed and started directly. 

Today I was rembered to observe & note my feelings - in a smooth way (that’s why I did it directly as well ;)).

I LOVE the function to be able to add your own/ special content to better explain/ express yourself - mega‼️

After that, I looked a little around in the app - feels well 😇

My personal problem: I am not familiar enough with the English language. Even feelings are hard to name. For that reason the abo/€ seems to expensive for me. So sorry!!

Ps should you need someone to translate? I‘d improve my English, if so 😉
author: N🔆c

title: Excelente aplicación
body:
Univi ha superado mis expectativas. La interfaz es muy clara y fácil de usar, lo que hace que la experiencia sea intuitiva desde el primer momento. Me encanta lo fluida que es y cómo organiza la información de manera ordenada, sin complicaciones. Además, las funciones que ofrece son realmente útiles y prácticas para el día a día.
Se nota que está pensada con el usuario en mente, y el diseño moderno la hace aún más agradable de utilizar. ¡Totalmente recomendable!

author: ReviewerUnknown

title: Nice videos but bad app execution
body: The videos are nice and explain different strategies to manage parts of ADHD. However, the app itself seems to be poorly done. There’s no way to undo actions done by mistake. The counters do not have any such alarm or anything so as ADHD I could be completely doing something else and completely forget about the app or taking a break.
author: klarkent91
